text:
anya: Heads-up — ACME asked us to prioritize a bundled recommendation for batching + prefix caching + a quantization suggestion for their mobile inference flow. They want an estimate for effort & launch risks by end of week.

mike: ok. do we have telemetry on their request patterns? QPS, seq len distro? :eyes:

samir: ACME sent logs. short convo: most requests are 1–2 prompt turns, median seq ~256, spikes to 1024 on long-form. QPS ~150 steady, burst 700 for a few mins.

liz: from infra POV: bursts at 700 will push us into cross-host batching territory. if we use aggressive prefix caching we can keep p99 latency under 250ms for most cases. quantization helps cost but may affect top-k for rerank stuff.

anya: key asks from ACME: (1) clear config recommendations they can copy into their prod rollout, (2) a safety net eval that flags regressions after we ship (eval-triggered alerts), (3) an estimate of cost savings w/ quant + batch.

samir: propose we split asks into 3 deliverables and assign priority bins:
- P0: copy-ready batching + cache config + quick sanity tests (must have)
- P1: quantization recipe for their model variants + guidance on quality vs size tradeoffs
- P2: continuous eval alerting integration (signals + thresholds)

nora: +1. for P0 we can template two configs: conservative (low batch sizes, per-host) and aggressive (cross-host batching + async batching). include `max_batch_delay_ms` knobs.

mike: rough engineer estimate: P0 ~ 3 dev-days (template + test harness + doc), P1 ~ 6–8 dev-days (bench + regressions + quant configs), P2 ~ 5 dev-days (telemetry hooks + eval-runbook + alert rules).

anya: can we be more granular about launch gates for P0? ACME wants a canary before full rollout.

liz: launch gates for P0 suggestion:
- Canary on 5% traffic for 48h
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost delta, error rate
- Quality check: perplexity/regression on 1k representative prompts (ACME-provided)
- Auto-rollback if p99 increases by >20% or failure rate >0.5%

samir: add eval-triggered alert basics now (low-effort): run the 1k prompts every 6h, compute concordance score, and fire an alert to #customer-ops if concordance drops >5% from baseline. P0 can include the scaffolding but not full ops playbook.

anya: good. what about recommended quant formats? FP16 vs int8?

liz: for their hardware mix (A10 + some T4s), FP16 is low-risk and gets ~1.8x perf. int8/4-bit quant yields bigger savings but we need per-task evals — some reranking workloads drop in rerank NDCG. P1 should include a quant QA matrix.

mike: dependencies: model-team needs to publish the compatible quant artifacts, infra needs a canary lane, and @solutions should prep the customer config doc.

nora: tagging for docs: include example YAML: ```
serving:
  batching:
    enabled: true
    max_batch_size: 48
    max_batch_delay_ms: 12
  prefix_cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl_seconds: 3600
  quant_profile: "fp16-conservative"
```

anya: ACTIONS:
- mike -> confirm dev-day estimates and slot owners by Wed EOD
- samir -> prepare the 1k prompt eval set + baseline run (due Thu)
- liz -> draft P0 canary runbook + rollback thresholds (due Thu)
- nora -> draft customer-ready config + short explainer (due Fri)

mike: noted. I'll ping infra to carve a canary pool and add cross-host batching ops doc.

nora: putting a small checklist in the ticket: docs, canary script, eval harness, postmortem template.

ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket #INF-4231 for canary infra and assign to infra-oncall.

samir: quick risk callout — inference caching prefix collisions if prompt templates vary a lot. we should include a guidance bullet for canonicalizing prompts and a TTL conservative default.

anya: copy. also add a customer constraint: they want no model-weight changes during the canary (so quant rollout must be separate change window). call that out in the handoff doc.

liz: last note — for cost saving est: I can run sample perf/throughput bench tomorrow and give a delta for fp16 vs int8. estimate in ticket will be provisional. :thumbsup:

anya: perfect. thanks all. I'll synthesize this into an email to ACME + attach the P0 canary checklist once Liz and Samir have artifacts.

mike: :raised_hands:

nora: FYI I've added the deliverables to the roadmap swimlane and linked this thread.

anya: closing loop here — will follow up with the consolidated scoping doc by EOD Fri.
